text_block_list.text: It happened when I stopped by the academy's dance studio—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right hand, left hand, step back!
Raise both hands and wasshoi, wass—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?!
Ah, I'm so sorry! Are you alright?!
choice_data_list: I'm fine. You're really pumped up
I'm fine. You're really pumped up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! For the upcoming Winning Live,
I really want to dance super cool in the center!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I watched Dia-chan's live,
my motivation's just been overflowing non-stop!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Dia-chan is truly amazing!
The way she sparkles on stage really feels diamond-class!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan never hesitates or gets stage fright,
and it really shines through in her performance!
It struck a chord deep inside me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It made me want to dance just as cool
as Dia-chan does!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But thinking about so many things at once
got me all tangled up in knots...
choice_data_list: Why not ask someone for advice?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Advice... Oh, you're right!
I'll go ask a senior I look up to!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Teio-san! Please!
Teach me the secret to putting on a cool live!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm! This is definitely a job for me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey! Leave it to me~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's take a video of our dancing
to see how it looks! I'll dance too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
R-Right next to you, Teio-san?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, you over there!
Record us on your smartphone, please~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Now then, now then.
Let's see how it turned out... Play!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-Standing next to you, Teio-san,
my rough edges stand out so much, it's embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's not really about rough edges, or rather...
Maybe something before that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, while you were dancing,
you were only focusing on me, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eh?!
T-That is... yes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, good girl for being honest! But during a live,
I'm not the one you should be focusing on, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You see, what I love about lives
is hearing everyone shout, "You're so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I used to scream, "You're so cool!" at the President,
and now I'm the one hearing it! Isn't that the best?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's why I give it everything I've got at the Winning Live!
Like, "I won! Look how cool I am!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Kita-chan?
How do you feel during a Winning Live?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How do I feel...?
I...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Winning Live... Back then,
I cheered for Teio-san until my voice went completely hoarse.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just like that day, now there will be people
cheering for me with everything they've got...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: In that case, I... I want to...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I get it now. Dia-chan understood that all along,
which is why she looked so incredibly cool.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san!
I want to dance cool on stage
and make sure everyone has the best time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup! First hurdle cleared!
Now, all that's left is to push straight forward!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll resume practicing right away!!

Expressing her own feelings through the live—
having gained that crucial hint,
Kitasan Black seemed to have taken another step forward.
